Description: The featured course title in the MindBridge homepage hero reads "Intoduction to Data Analytics" instead of "Introduction to Data Analytics". The typo is visible to every visitor who lands on the homepage. All links and enrolment still work.

When any learner selects Place Order on the course checkout page, the page crashes and shows a 500 error. No order confirmation appears and no enrolment is created. This happens for every user on every browser, and there is no workaround - nobody can pay for or enrol in a course.

Summary: MB-203 - Admin enrollment report crashes on Internet Explorer 10
Description: For internal admin users, opening the Enrolment Report and filtering by "Last 3 Years" freezes and crashes the browser. It has only been reproduced on Internet Explorer 10. The report works correctly on Chrome, Edge, and Firefox. MindBridge officially dropped support for Internet Explorer 10 last year.
On the Account settings page, the Cancel button sits two or three pixels lower than the Save changes button. Both buttons are fully functional; only the alignment is off.

Summary: MB-205 - Catalog search filter returns inaccurate results
Description: When a learner filters the course catalogue by Level: Advanced, the results also include several Beginner courses. The correct Advanced courses are listed too, but the results are cluttered with irrelevant ones. Learners can still find and enrol in the course they want.
